summary: Bilibili filed a 6-K announcing proposed offerings of US$700 million convertible senior notes due 2031, a concurrent equity placement, and concurrent share repurchases. The notes are zero-coupon, convertible into Class Z ordinary shares, with US$200 million subscribed by Tencent. Proceeds will fund the Delta and Tencent repurchases, AI-driven growth, and general corporate purposes. The notes may be redeemed after September 2029 under certain conditions. Terms to be set at pricing. The company will conduct an off-market share buy-back in Hong Kong. Watch for conversion rate, repurchase size, and pricing details.
